_comment: Scale-gate thresholds for tools/bot_swarm/scale_gate.py (issue #520). Single source of truth for the gate numbers. See docs/load-testing.md.

pr._comment: Deterministic PR tier: only machine-independent metrics are hard-gated (bandwidth + admission + KB/s baseline). tick-Hz is a total-collapse tripwire; tick-ms is advisory (0 = disabled) because the client-side proxy and CPU timing are noisy on shared runners.

reference._comment: Strict tier for the 8-core/16GB reference instance (or a self-hosted runner via --strict). tick-ms p99 enforced there; advisory on hosted runners.

soak._comment: 2 h soak-stability run. Same strict thresholds; the server self-reports RSS in the tick metrics (#707) and the leak gate hard-fails if growth exceeds assert_max_rss_growth_kb (~256 MiB over 2 h).

entity-scale._comment: Entity-pool + SpatialIndex scaling characterisation (#573). Sweeps entity count x sim worker count via FL_TEST_SPAWN_AI / FL_SIM_WORKER_THREADS, driven from the [world] load-spawn affordance. Advisory only (baselined=false): reads server_tick.entities + tick p99 into the summary but never gates the committed KB/s baseline. Reference-tier (nightly / workflow_dispatch) — needs the 8-core reference box for meaningful CPU timing.

overrun._comment: Synthetic tick-overrun profile (#574): proves the #514 graceful overrun governor ENGAGES and SHEDS rather than spiralling. Runs with the governor ON (governor=true -> FL_LOADTEST_GOVERNOR=1) and deterministically overloads a serialize-bound tick with test_spawn_ai=5000 at sim_workers=1 (the #573 characterisation measured ~36.8 Hz governor-off here — a large portable margin below 60 Hz). Gates: max_load_factor 0.99 fails if the governor never engaged (load_factor stayed 1.0 — the primary bite, verified during dev to drop to ~0.25 governor-on vs 1.0 governor-off); max_dropped_ticks 100 is the graceful-not-spiral bound (a small allowance absorbs the one-time startup-spawn + EWMA-ramp transient before the governor engages — measured ~24 drops in a debug smoke; a genuine spiral produces thousands over 90 s); --assert-min-entities 5000 (auto from the load-spawn) confirms the overload took. baselined=false: the shed KB/s must NEVER touch the committed bandwidth baseline. Reference tier only (nightly / workflow_dispatch) — the collapse margin is reliable only on a controlled runtime.

congestion._comment: Synthetic congestion profile (#714): proves the #518 per-peer AIMD send-rate controller ENGAGES on a degraded link and RECOVERS when it clears. bot_swarm routes its clients through a local lossy UDP proxy that drops 5% of datagrams + adds 100 ms one-way delay in a mid-run window ([25s, 55s) from proxy start — after the connect ramp, ending ~35s before the run ends so the additive ramp-up has a clean tail to recover in). The +100 ms delay (+200 ms RTT, far over the controller's 40 ms margin) is the deterministic engage trigger; the 5% loss is a secondary delivery stressor kept BELOW the level that trips ENet's own peer timeout (a 15% dev run dropped a client mid-window, failing admission — verified 5%+100ms keeps all peers connected while still engaging to the 10 Hz floor). Gates (schema v5 run-long watermarks): congestion_min_send_hz must fall to <= 30 (engaged; the controller floor is 10 Hz) and congestion_recovered_send_hz must climb back to >= 55 (recovered). baselined=false: degraded KB/s must never touch the committed bandwidth baseline. Reference tier only (nightly / workflow_dispatch).

entity-churn._comment: Heavier-AI-mix + projectile-churn characterisation (#580, extends the #573 entity-scale matrix which deliberately used cheap static loiterers). Pre-spawns entities with a representative controller mix (60% loiter / 25% pursuit [EntityManager::get on a moving target each tick] / 15% patrol [a StateMachineController whose AnyEntityWithinRange transitions run SpatialIndex::queryRadius EVERY tick — the expensive AI path the governor's AI stride decimates]) and runs the projectile-churn generator (120 spawn+reap/s, 3 s TTL => ~360 extra live entities at steady state; continuous EntityPool alloc/free + SnapshotDespawn TLV traffic). Compare ai_ms / collision_ms / maintenance_ms against the same entity_spawn_counts points in the entity-scale matrix (docs/entity-scale-characterization.md). Advisory only (baselined=false). Reference tier (workflow_dispatch on demand, like entity-scale).
